title: Rockstar Reveals Some Of The Radio Stations And Songs In GTA 6
summary: The company also confirmed you'll be able to listen to music and podcasts while on foot via your phone
text: Rockstar Reveals Some Of The Radio Stations And Songs In GTA 6 Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News Rockstar Reveals Some Of The Radio Stations And Songs In GTA 6 The company also confirmed you'll be able to listen to music and podcasts while on foot via your phone Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Rockstar Games By Zack Zwiezen Published October 8, 2026 | Comments ( 19 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Games Sure, Cyberleek dropped a new big Grand Theft Auto 6 leak , but that won’t stop Rockstar Games from also sharing new official information about its upcoming open-world sequel. Today’s big news drop is a small preview of just some of the radio stations and songs that players will be able to listen to in their cars and while running around on foot. On October 8, Rockstar updated its official GTA 6 website and added a whole section dedicated to the in-game radio stations and music. According to the studio, GTA 6 features the “biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio” yet seen in the franchise. Thanks to some previous leaks and trailers , we knew some of the music and stations that players could expect to find in GTA 6, but this is the first time the company has officially pulled back the curtain on the radio stations that will be featured in the game. And there’s some good stuff in here. The new music section of the GTA 6 website includes previews from six different radio stations set to appear in the game. Here’s the list of stations and what kind of music to expect on them: Flash FM – Pop music hits Back Country Radio – Classic country hits and outlaw tracks Cocoteo FM – Modern Latin hits and bangers The Chamber 106.6 – Hard rock and speed metal Afro Bank FM – Amapiano and African hits Dirty South Classics – Regional rap and hip hop classics The previews include a few snippets from each station’s DJs as well as some bits of songs. And there’s some good stuff in here, including “Electric Feel” by MGMT, “Raining Blood” by Slayer, and “Don’t Come Home a Drinkin’” by Loretta Lynn. Truly something for everyone. Keep in mind, these aren’t all the stations. Instead, this is just a preview of some of the music choices that you’ll be able to jam out to when GTA 6 launches in November. Rockstar also confirmed that for the first time in franchise history, players will be able to listen to these and other radio stations on foot via Jason and Lucia’s phones. Players will also have a selection of “on-demand” podcasts that can be played while on foot or in your car. Rockstar also promises it has more to share about in-game music and the GTA 6 album coming soon. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter.
